Scratchpad of scripts per finding (Shannon)

epics.name: Memory and knowledge

Per-run memory separate from reusable guide / answer / code knowledge, retrieved with a threshold and a limit of 3 (PentAGI)
Facts (append-only), Intents (claimed with a heartbeat lease), Hints; workers coordinate only through the board (Cairn)
epics.we_build: Project recon into the graph; a cross-engagement lessons store; a fact / intent / hint board.

epics.name: Published results

A self-critical coverage audit: complete / backlog / excluded per class
Historical results labelled as historical (PentestGPT)
Real-world receipts with links, pending marked pending (Hacker Bob)

Declarative login flow with TOTP and a success condition, validated first (Shannon)
OpenAPI / Postman contracts as input so every declared endpoint is tested (Strix)
22 phases including IDOR, race conditions, open redirect, CORS (Xalgorix)
epics.we_build: Deterministic probes for SQLi, XSS, SSTI, command injection, redirect, traversal, CORS; identities and an authorization matrix; operator-supplied contracts.

they_do_right: 100-150+ tools by category; health endpoint with tool availability (HexStrike)
Missing tools are skipped or substituted, visibly (CyberStrikeAI)
epics.we_build: Buggy inherits the breadth. Verify it: a tool and domain readiness matrix from the real sandbox.

epics.name: Reports and developer workflow
they_do_right: PDF + Markdown + JSON + SARIF, validated findings only (Shannon)
GitHub Action with `fail-on-severity` and SARIF upload; incomplete is not clean (Shannon)
CVSS, PoC and remediation per finding (Xalgorix)
Fix loop: PRs and retest (RedAmon CypherFix, Strix Cloud)
epics.we_build: One report over verified findings in Markdown, HTML, JSON; SARIF; a CI gate and Action; retest.

epics.name: UI, API, observability
they_do_right: Live run page: phase, tool activity, findings (PentAGI, RedAmon)
Approve / deny inline; stop and steer (RedAmon)
Execution monitor: repeated tool calls trigger an intervention; per-role caps (PentAGI)
Traces of LLM and tool calls with cost (PentAGI)
epics.we_build: A run page in the dashboard (recon, approvals, findings); a loop guard; per-run telemetry.

Grade for submission (Hacker Bob)
epics.we_build: A program brief from scope, recon and report history; duplicate risk.

epics.name: Integration and proof
they_do_right: Nothing counts until it runs on the real stack

epics.name: URL in, report out
they_do_right: One input (a URL) and one output (a report a defender can act on)

they_do_right: The best part is no part
epics.we_build: Remove every module, service, image, test and document that the URL-to-report path does not use. Anything deleted that turns out to be needed is added back with a reason.
